en.t: No, I would run into someone in the corridor.

units.source_text: 她好像完全变成了一个娴静的淑女。

en.t: She seemed to have completely turned into a quiet, refined lady.

units.source_text: 待岛村从浴池回来时，她已经巧妙地在头上裹上手巾，勤快地打扫起房间来。

en.t: By the time Shimamura came back from the bath, she had already deftly wrapped a towel around her head and was busily cleaning the room.
